# A sale whose residual lands on a half cent, written as an ordinary
# transaction rather than a payment block.
#
# 45.00 USD carried at 1.405 CAD/USD is 63.225 CAD — half a cent — and 62.00
# CAD is what the sale fetched, so `$residual$` is 1.225 CAD. The residual is a
# figure this tool computes, not one the file states, so GnuCash rounds it to
# the cent the way it rounds the cost beside it: both reach 63.23 and 1.23, and
# the entry balances exactly.
#
# What this fixture produces:
#
#   Assets:Bank:USD    -45.00 USD   value -63.23 CAD   share_price 6323/4500
#   Assets:Bank         62.00 CAD
#   Income:FX Gain       1.23 CAD   ($residual$)
#
# and no Imbalance split, because the two rounded figures agree. Refusing the
# residual instead — as a stated half-cent amount is refused — would blame the
# writer for a number they never wrote, and would accept as a payment block the
# same sale it rejects as a transaction.
#
# The exported rate is 6323/4500, not the 1.405 stated here, and that is not a
# defect: the value had to reach the cent, and 63.23 over 45.00 is 6323/4500 —
# 1.405 + 1/9000. A stated rate is what the value is computed from; it does not
# come back verbatim, and nothing should assume it does. Import this file and
# export it to see for yourself.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_half_cent_rounding.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-10 * "Buy 45 USD at 1.405"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 45.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.405"
		value: "63.23"
	Assets:Bank -63.23 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-63.23"

2026-03-01 * "Sell 45 USD for 62.00 CAD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -45.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.405"
	Assets:Bank 62.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "62.00"
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
